Sampling & MOQ Questions

Minimums are per style per colourway. 50 pieces of one design in one colour; three colours is three times 50. Specialist fabrics and trims can carry separate minimums — mills that will not cut below a set yardage, trims that come in fixed box quantities. Where that applies to your order the quote says so up front. Ask for physical swatches before committing to a sample; they are faster and cheaper and settle most fabric questions on their own.

Broader questions are answered on our FAQ page, and the order itself is walked through stage by stage on how it works.

Are sample fees refundable?

Sample cost varies by garment and is confirmed in writing before anything is made, so there is no surprise. Where a fee applies it is 100% credited toward your first production order from 50 pieces, which means on a sample you go on to produce you are not paying for it twice.

How do I order a sample from FABRIOZA?

Send your design, reference photo or tech pack through the quote form. We confirm the spec within 24 hours, build the tech pack free if you don't have one, and dispatch your pre-production sample in 5–7 business days by DHL.

What is FABRIOZA's minimum order quantity?

50 pieces per style is our standard minimum — one design across your chosen colors and sizes, and the best unit price. New brands can start from a 20-piece run at a higher unit price, so a first order is a real test rather than a gamble. Sublimated team kits start at 15–20 sets.

Can I negotiate a lower MOQ?

You don't need to negotiate — the lower tier is already published: a 20-piece trial order at a quoted per-unit price, with the premium over bulk credited back when you scale. That is usually better than a negotiated one-off exception because it is a standard, repeatable program with the same QC as bulk.

How long does sampling take?

5–7 business days from approved spec to dispatch, plus 2–4 days DHL delivery depending on destination. Rush sampling is available — ask with your quote.
